items.title: Surge in networks scans targeting Cisco ASA devices raise concerns
items.description: Large network scans have been targeting Cisco ASA devices, prompting warnings from cybersecurity researchers that it could indicate an upcoming flaw in the products. [...]

items.title: 'MostereRAT' Malware Blends In, Blocks Security Tools
items.description: A threat actor is using a sophisticated EDR-killing malware tool in a campaign to maintain long-term, persistent access on Windows systems.

items.title: Salesloft Breached via GitHub Account Compromise
items.description: The breach kickstarted a massive supply chain attack that led to the compromise of hundreds of Salesforce instances through stolen OAuth tokens.
